dict.string: RayPrompt listens for questions and spoken guidance only while you run a session. Audio is processed on this iPhone and never saved.
RayPrompt transcribes speech on this iPhone to detect questions and synchronize the teleprompter. Enabling Gemini sends questions and selected context to Google.
Bluetooth connects to your RayNeo iO glasses to show answers on the display.
Only when you turn on editor pairing: your code editor on the same Wi-Fi reports which lines of the current Code Tutor step are present.
